pool.text: The city of Porto Alegre was officially established in this year.
The official foundation date of the city of Porto Alegre occurred.
Porto Alegre officially became the capital city of the province.
Immigrants from all over the world started arriving in the region.
The Farrapos War started with a confrontation near the Azenha bridge.
The oldest museum in the state was created in the city.
The greatest Book Fair in the Americas began taking place in October.
The city became known worldwide through hosting the World University Games.
An important cultural auditorium was inaugurated and relocated to Farroupilha Park.
The Lami José Lutzenberger Biological Reserve was established in the Lami neighborhood.
People joined the movement for free elections in one of the largest demonstrations.
The first metro line was inaugurated between the Central Public Market and Sapucaia do Sul.
The first full participatory budgeting process was developed in the city.
A natural gas pipeline from Bolivia to Brazil was completed with its terminus here.
The city began hosting one of the world's largest free software events called FISL.
Paris became a partner city of Porto Alegre.
The city stood out for hosting the first edition of the World Social Forum.
The Lami José Lutzenberger Biological Reserve reopened after being closed for more than ten years.
The 9th Assembly of the World Council of Churches was held in the city.
A building designed by Portuguese architect Álvaro Siza was opened offering views of the river.
